# Savaru IV - Kohtalon Mies v3.0_b1117b (beta)

A **beta** of the 3.0 line, built from the test pack as it stands on 2026-11-17. Expect rough edges; the last release is still 2.6.0.

## Changes in this build

- **Savaru's Chat 0.4.0: friends.**
  - Send a friend request with **Add Friend** on the new **Friends** page, Add Friend at the top of a private chat, by right-clicking a player's face in chat, or with `/friend add <player>`. The other player sees the request with **Accept / Decline** in chat and at the top of their Friends list; once they accept, you are on each other's list.
  - The Friends list shows who is online. Click an online friend to start a private chat; × removes a friend from both lists.
  - **Online / offline alerts** when a friend joins or leaves, with an on/off switch at the top of the Friends page (or `/friend notify on|off`).
  - **New Market channel:** showcased items and Savaru's Trading sale broadcasts now go there instead of All Chat / Announcements.
- **Growthology 0.2.61: resets give everything back.**
  - **Reset** now returns every spent skill point. You earn one full reset at growth level 150, one at 200 and one at 300; the confirm message shows how many you have left.
  - **Clear** on a single skill (or talent node) returns all of its points, with no limit.
- **Worldology 1.1.7:** quest and HUD text (objectives, daily/weekly tasks, mode, rank names, experience popup) now shows in your own language on the server; before, it stayed in English.
- **SVR Quests 0.6.1:** Back returns to the page you came from instead of the first page, and the journal reopens where you left it.
- **SVR Inventory 1.1.0:** your Numismatic wallet (gold / silver / bronze) is shown below the storage panel.
- **Sound in the isometric view.**
  - Dungeons Iso now hears from your character instead of the far-away camera (`soundListenerBias` 1.0), so footsteps and ambient sounds no longer sound far away.
  - Cinematic Iso Compat 1.3.0: Sound Physics traces walls and echo from your character, so a camera inside or behind a wall no longer muffles everything.
- **Mod updates:** Bargain! 2.0.0, Diegesis 1.0.0-beta.11, Diorama 0.10.2, Enchanted Fishing Line 1.1.1, EntityCulling 1.12.1, Hands-On Delight 1.5.0, Kaleidoscope Tavern 1.2.0.15, minuit 2.0.1, Mobs of Mythology 3.1.0, More RPG Library 2.8.2, Particular 1.6.1, Punchy 3.2b, Spiral Abyss 2.0.7, Streams Reflowing 2.17.5.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1117)

- **Savaru's Chat 0.3.0.**
  - Channels are kept apart: other players' public messages and your own stay in All Chat and no longer open extra chat targets. Server messages, /say announcements and command feedback go to the Announcements channel. Party, private and group chats are separate from All Chat.
  - **+ button** next to the chat targets: pick an online player to start a private chat, or **create a group** and invite players with **Invite** (top right). Invited players get Join / Decline.
  - Tooltips of showcased items draw above the item icons.
  - **Colours & style** in the chat settings: 14 colours plus four themes (Default slate, Night, Warm wood, Forest).
- **Level-up animations.** Worldology 1.1.6: a large "LEVEL UP!" in the middle of the screen, the level counting up with an arrow, and "Rank Up: old ➜ new" on a rank change; the level-up and rank-up chat messages are gone. Growthology 0.2.60 has its own green animation, played only when Growthology is not linked to Worldology.
- **Dungeon HUD 0.6.0.** Combat Roll's charges and key are always on the bar (lower right); when the bar is unfolded they sit left of the SVR Engine custom skills.
- **Affixology 3.11.2.** Gems socketed into worn armour now give their bonus (they did nothing before).

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1116b)

- **Savaru's Trading 1.3.0.**
  - New **History** tab: your last 50 marketplace purchases and sales (item, the other player, time, amount).
  - Sale income is no longer paid straight into your purse, and no longer paid on login. It waits in the new **Earnings** tab, which turns gold and reads "Earnings to collect" while anything waits. The tab lists every uncollected sale; **Collect all** pays it out. On login, a chat line says how many sales are waiting.
  - Income that was already waiting for you shows up there as "Earlier earnings".
- **Savaru Compat Fixes 1.1.1.** The server could crash while saving a projectile in flight that had no owner (a Mine Cells scorpion spit). Such an entity is now left out of the save instead.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1116)

- **Performance pass.** On one test PC with the same scripted scenes: combat 21 → 51 FPS, many mobs on screen 30 → 57, walking around 51 → 80, menus +25–35%. Other PCs will show other numbers, but the gains should be similar in proportion.
  - **Removed: Subtle Effects** (its ambient particles were one of the larger costs).
  - **Wakes:** mobs and dropped items no longer leave wakes in water (players and boats still do), and the wake texture has half the resolution.
  - **Punchy! facial expressions are off.**
  - **Savaru Compat Fixes 1.1.0** removes wasted work inside other mods without changing how they look. Loot Beams draws all beams in one pass and no longer re-checks the shader pack and every item's beam settings each frame. Perception trails really stop when they are turned off. Punchy no longer rebuilds its animation-pack list on every lookup. The AtlasVFX aura outlines use a coarser mesh. Extra Spell Attributes no longer runs its Dissolution check on every health read, which also lightens the server.
  - **Savaru mods:** Chat 0.2.3, Dungeon Bar 0.5.2, Growthology 0.2.59 (reads its config only when the file changes), Worldology 1.1.5, and Affixology 3.11.1, which takes much less server time because reading a weapon's affixes no longer copies all of its item data.
- **Affixology 3.11.1: Structure Analyzer.** "Other" materials no longer need experience levels, and the Confirm button no longer turns grey with "Not enough levels".

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1115d)

- **New: SVR Tooltips 1.0.0** replaces Legendary Tooltips. Every vanilla rarity and every Affixology quality has its own ornate metal frame, and the higher the quality, the richer the frame; the top tiers have animated borders.
  - **Exclusive** (Construction Cube weapons): the frame sparkles gold. A white-hot light runs once around it, then golden smoke and flames rise.
  - **Unique** (the Savaru weapons): the silver frame flickers between darkness and white light, with an occasional burst of gold flame.
  - Tooltips fade in and settle in about 0.17 s. The first line shows the item's icon, name and quality.
- **Scroller 1.1.0:** long tooltips keep their title pinned while the mouse wheel scrolls the rest. Alt + mouse wheel zooms the whole tooltip. Tooltips stay 15 px inside the top and bottom of the screen.
- **Removed:** Legendary Tooltips, and its libraries Iceberg and Prism (nothing else used them).
- **Keys:** in the Click to Move key preset, the Combat Styles customizer is now **End** and the equipment screen **Insert**. Their defaults K and J clashed with the quest journal and the market.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1115c)

- **Affixology 3.11.0: enchanting constructed weapons.** Swords, bows, crossbows, guns and staffs made in the Construction Cube can now be enchanted at an enchanting table (as in vanilla, only while they have no enchantments yet).
- **Affixology 3.11.0: Structure Analyzer.** "Other" materials now also raise one enchantment the weapon already has by 1 level, past its normal maximum. Enchant the weapon first; without enchantments only a stat goes up.
- **Affixology 3.11.0: weapon imports.** Imported affixes have no cap any more and go into the weapon's own affix list. Two weapons of the same kind but different rarity are no longer mixed up: the import uses the copy you dragged in. In survival, imports no longer stop with "used up" while you still have the item, the message says how many you need and have, and edit mode needs 1 copy per new import (was 2).
- **Affixology 3.11.0: drafts.** The Construction Cube and the Transcendent Remodeling Table canvas have Save / Load draft buttons; drafts stay after you close the game.
- **SVR Engine 0.13.0:** every Skill Forge effect has its own delay (0-10 s), and there are four new effects: Explosion, Meteor, Storm and Frost.
- **Dungeon Bar 0.5.1:** the bar unfolds and folds at the same speed, 0.2 s.
- **Quests:** a new repeatable quest in chapter 1 gives you the Savaru guide book again if you lose it.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1115b)

- **SVR Engine 0.12.2: Skill Forge.** Craft a Skill Forge (a book, two amethyst shards, a crafting table and three cobbled deepslate) and design up to 4 skills of your own, like Spell Engine weapon skills. Each skill has a trigger (Alt + Q / W / E / R, or a passive such as melee hit, getting hurt, kill, jump or every few seconds), up to 6 conditions, an optional bound weapon, a delivery (beam, area, target or self) and up to 3 effects (damage, drain, lightning, fire, heal, buffs, dash, blink and more). In isometric view, key skills aim toward the mouse cursor. Point costs scale by doubling: twice the damage or range costs twice the points, twice the cooldown or mana cost costs half. A long cooldown and high mana cost together lower the cost to one tenth at most, and every skill costs at least 1 point.
- **Dungeon Bar 0.5.0:** your Skill Forge skills show in the four slots on the right side of the bar, with icons, cooldowns and keys.
- **Growthology 0.2.58: Traditional Chinese.** The Growthology screen and the talent tree (skills, milestones, attributes, talent nodes, buttons) now follow the game language, and switching language applies at once.
- **Keys:** the Left Alt bindings of Spell Engine (bypass spell hotbar), Lootology (cursor), Cinematic look, Souls Weapons (ability) and AdventureZ (dragonfly down) are unbound so they do not fire with the new Alt + Q / W / E / R skill keys.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1114e)

- **Affixology 3.10.2:** Construction Cube knuckles no longer show as a large magenta and black cube in your hand. They now draw your own design. They still count as Forcemaster fist weapons, but Forcemaster's knock-up on hit only works with its own knuckles.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1114d)

- **Affixology 3.10.0: new weapon kinds in the Construction Cube.** You can now make Knuckles, a Mace, a Hammer, a Spear, a Sickle and a Gun. Each one uses the matching Better Combat moves and counts for the class mods that use that weapon kind (for example, Forcemaster knuckles and Archers crossbows). A gun loads like a crossbow and fires a fast, straight shot. In the cube settings, Shift + click on the kind button goes back one kind.
- **Affixology 3.10.0: drawing with depth on the 2D page.** New Z − / + buttons jump between depth layers (now -8 to +8, up to 32 layers). With Onion on, layers in front of the one you are drawing and the 3D model parts show faintly as guides.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1114c)

- **SVR Inventory 1.0.1: fixed an item in your hotbar being replaced by a copy of your belt weapon.** It happened while dual wielding (a one-handed weapon in the off hand) with a belt weapon picked from the tool wheel: every off-hand attack overwrote the selected hotbar item. The hotbar is now left alone.
- **Dungeon Bar 0.4.0: your spells are on the bar.** Spell Engine spells show to the left of the centre diamond with their icons, cooldowns and keys, and Spell Engine's own spell hotbar is hidden (the cast bar stays). While the hotbar is open they shrink into one row of small icons; when it folds they grow into rows of four with their keys, and a square level diamond shows your tier and level with the experience bar around its edge. The hand diamond and hotbar slots are larger, and the off-hand slot is no longer shown.
- The talent tree tutorial quest now only asks you to read that **Y** opens the talent tree.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1114b)

- **Affixology 3.9.0: armour can be awakened to Strange.** Put an Unrivaled or Beyond Imagination armour replica, an Infusion Mold and an enhancement stone into the Infusion Station, the same way as weapons. You get three wing effects to choose from, and the chosen one triples the piece's affix values.
  - **Chestplate and leggings:**
    - Perfect Defense: after every two attacks you take, the next one deals 0 damage.
    - Blazing Aura: every 2 seconds, flames burst 15 blocks around you, dealing 150 + 35% of your attack as fire damage to enemies.
    - Counterfeit: a 50% chance to take no damage from a hit and heal 2.5 times that damage instead.
  - **Helmet:**
    - Holy Light Veil: you glow at light level 15 (LambDynamicLights).
    - Breathing Mask: you use no air.
    - Energy Veil: your mana stays full.
  - **Boots:**
    - Last-Second Escape: a hit of more than 30% of your health gives +700% speed for 1 second (15 s cooldown).
    - All-Terrain Boots: walk on water and lava, with no lava or fire damage; sneak to sink.
    - Power Leap: every 10 s your next jump goes 10 times higher. Landing deals true damage to enemies within 30 blocks; you take no fall damage, then move 70% slower for 5 s.
- **Affixology 3.8.2: the Structure Analyzer shows when you are short of levels.** Each "other" material, such as a diamond, costs 1000 levels. Before, the analysis was refused silently: the weapon stayed the same and nothing was used up. Now the confirm button turns grey with "Not enough levels", and its tooltip shows the cost and your current level.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1114)

- **Dungeon Bar 0.3.6:** the hotbar folds away when you are not using it. After 3 seconds without touching it, both ends slide in toward the middle with a shower of sparks, slots 1-9 shrink away and the health and mana orbs grow; the item in your hand and the offhand stay. Picking a slot or opening an inventory unfolds it at once. Set the delay (or turn it off) with **Fold hotbar after** in the Dungeon Bar config screen.
- **Savaru Trading 1.2.0:** finer marketplace categories. Armor is split by slot (Helmets, Chestplates, Leggings, Boots); weapons into Melee, Ranged and Spell, with separate Shields, Accessories, Gems and Tools. Modded gear is sorted much more reliably, and existing listings move into the new categories automatically.
- **Worldology 1.1.4:** no territory can reach into the 100 x 100 area around the overworld spawn. Server operators can list, visit and delete any player's territory (`/worldology territory all`).
- **Dungeonology 1.3.2:** F1 now hides the dungeon timer, party HUD and scoreboard with the rest of the interface.
- **SVR Engine 0.11.0:** in-game spell editor for operators (copy a spell, change its values, draw its icon).
- Updated: Diegesis 1.0.0-beta.8, Diorama 0.10.0, Entity Culling 1.12.0, FancyMenu 3.10.0, Hands-On Delight 1.4.0, Kaleidoscope Tavern 1.2.0.14, Punchy! Moves 1.0.9, Spiral Abyss 2.0.6, Yet Another Gravestone 0.3.2
- Removed: Fancy World Animations
- The quest journal opens in tree view by default.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1113)

- **Dungeons Iso:** the "first time" prompt asking whether to use the isometric view no longer appears. The isometric view is on from the start; switch it with F5 as before.
- Updated: Too Many Bows 4.1.1

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1111b)

- **Key fix:** Spiral Abyss's menu key is now **. (period)**. It was `` ` `` (grave accent), the same key as Dungeonology's scoreboard, so one press did both. You can change it in Controls.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1111)

- **Affixology 3.8.0: stations open as in-world 3D scenes.**
  - The Infusion Station, Sacrifice Altar, Structure Analyzer and Transcendent Remodeling Table no longer open a flat window. The camera flies to the block, and its slots become glowing rings on the block itself. Items you put in float in their place.
  - A hand reaches for the slot you hover or click and carries the stack on your cursor. When you confirm, the station plays a short work animation.
  - The panels sit at the bottom of the screen. The ▼ / ▲ tab above them folds them away for a full view of the station.
  - Your own character is hidden while a scene is open, so it doesn't block the shot. Closing the screen flies the camera back to you.
- **Affixology 3.8.1: more moves for the Construction Cube.** The move library also reads the attacks of the pack's other weapon mods (Simply Swords, Simply More and others). Use ◀ ▶ next to the library title to page through 16 weapon categories (chakram, warglaive, halberd, scythe, Witcher sword and more, 30 new moves), hover any move to preview it, and mix them freely into a combo.
- **Cinematic Iso Compat 1.2.0:** the isometric view hands the camera over to Bargain!'s haggling scenes, Hands-On Delight's cooking stations and the new Affixology station scenes, and comes back afterwards. The mouse cursor no longer disappears after closing a Bargain! trade.
- **New:**
  - **Bargain!**: haggle with villagers. Prices follow your reputation with the villager, the village and the world (with the minuit UI library).
  - **Farmer's Delight Refabricated** and **Hands-On Delight**, with **Diegesis**: cook on cutting boards, cooking pots, skillets and stoves in the world.
  - **Spiral Abyss**: a dimension of boss challenges over several floors, with its own gear.
  - **Enchanted Fishing Line**: the fishing line is drawn with physics.
- Removed: BE Style Wither and Pick Up Notifier.
- Quest journal: the tutorial group and chapter have new names and descriptions.
- Updated:
  - Bard (RPG Series Plus) 1.2.1
  - Collective 8.86
  - CreativeCore 2.13.54
  - Diorama 0.9.0
  - Extra Spell Attributes 2.1.0
  - Fabric API 0.116.18
  - Moonlight Lib 3.8.3
  - OctoLib 0.6.3
  - Ore Harvester 2.2
  - Punchy! - First person animations 3.2a
  - Punchy! Moves 1.0.8
  - Puzzles Lib 21.1.66
  - SpellHud Addon 1.0.9.2
  - Streams Reflowing 2.17.1
  - Too Many Bows 4.1.0
  - Village Spawn Point 6.1

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1107)

- **Affixology 3.7.2: previews, skill order, analyzer catalysts and edit bonuses.**
  - **No more twitching:** the character in the move preview (Construction Cube) and the skill preview (Transcendent Remodeling Table) holds still. With Punchy! Moves it used to fight the player's in-world animation.
  - **Move icons and sparks:** every move shows an icon for its hit area (↔ sweep, ↕ chop, → thrust, ↻ spin), and the preview swing leaves a trail of sparks along where it hits. Skill previews spark in the spell school's colour, and the remodel table lists each spell with its own icon.
  - **Skill order:** reorder installed skills with ▲ / ▼ in the remodel table's "Current" list (free). The spell hotbar follows that order. Remove a skill with ✕.
  - **Structure Analyzer catalysts:** three new slots take a nether star, a smithing template and an enhancement stone. Each one lowers the failure chance by 15% (70% → 55% → 40% → 25%) and one of each is used per analysis.
  - **Edit bonus:** editing an existing weapon now also gives the equipment import bonus for newly imported equipment: 10% of its base stats and the chosen affix at 50%.
  - **Bow and crossbow 3D parts get pull frames:** pick Idle / P1 / P2 / P3 at the top of the 3D view. A part added on a pull frame shows only in that frame (Idle = every frame), and the dots on each part row switch frames on or off.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1106c)

- **Affixology 3.7.1: Construction Cube update.**
  - **Weapon description:** the export page has a new "Lore…" button. Write a description (up to 160 characters) and it shows under the weapon's name in the tooltip. Buttons insert `&` codes, or type them yourself: 16 colours, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, obfuscated, reset and four fonts. A live preview shows the result.
  - **Off-hand:** a constructed weapon in the off-hand is now the exact mirror image of the main hand, no longer held at a skewed angle.
  - **Icons:** constructed weapons show a flat side view in the inventory, like every other weapon.
  - **3D page:** clicking in the 3D view no longer selects other parts, so you stop grabbing the wrong part by accident. Pick parts from the part list.
  - **Thickness** can go down to 0 (paper-thin).
- **New tutorial quests:** 13 quests after "Inventory, Bonuses and the Interface" walk through the camera, tool belt and tool wheel, skills and mana, talents and accessories, loot pickup, the map, the marketplace and coins, Dungeonology, affixes, the Construction Cube, monsters and regions, character saves and other useful keys.
- **"Level Up" (world level 20, starter weapon choice)** now starts by itself after the last tutorial quest. Before, it could not be started at all.
- Updated:
  - Moonlight Lib 3.8.2

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1106b)

- **Affixology 3.7.0: Construction Cube editor update.**
  - **Rotation knobs:** a selected 3D part shows X / Y / Z knobs. Drag one in a circle around the part to rotate it about that axis (Shift snaps to 15°).
  - **Axis lock:** hold Shift while dragging a part to move it along one X, Y or Z axis only.
  - **Thickness** now steps by 0.1 (1.0–8.0) when drawing and exporting; Shift steps by 1.
  - **Zoomable canvas:** the 32×32 / 64×64 switch is gone. The canvas starts as a 32×32 view and zooms like a paint program (−/+ or Ctrl+wheel, wheel to scroll, middle-drag to pan). Drawing past the edge grows it, up to 1024×1024.
  - **Equipment import bonus:** build a new weapon from an imported piece of equipment and it gets 25% of that item's base stats plus one affix of your choice from it at 80% strength. Click the ★ to choose the affix. The equipment is used up on export.
- Updated:
  - ANARCHY RPG 3.0.2
  - Collective 8.81
  - Punchy! Moves 1.0.7
  - Trial Guardians: The Mythical Four 2.1.0 (adds the Chimera structure)
  - Yet Another Gravestone 0.3.1

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1106)

- **Dungeonology 1.3.1: party levels.**
  - Your real Worldology level now shows everywhere in dungeons (party panel, scoreboard, dungeon list). Before, anyone below 30 showed as level 30.
  - Only the player who opens the dungeon needs the level for its difficulty. Party members of any level can join, and they are no longer pushed out of a dungeon that is above their level.
  - Party members below the dungeon's level see a red warning: **[Your level is below this dungeon. Tread carefully!!]**
  - The scoreboard lists the party by level, highest first.
  - Entry tickets drop a little more often from mobs.
- **Affixology 3.6.1:** no size limit on Construction Cube weapons, and the grip can sit outside the canvas (Shift moves it 10 cells at a time).
- **New quests:** "Join a Dungeon" (reach world level 30: 32 entry tickets) and "Take On a Dungeon" (enter any dungeon: 5 entry tickets and a copper ring).
- Updated:
  - Moonlight Lib 3.8.1
  - Smooth Movement 3.3.1
  - Yet Another Gravestone 0.3

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1105b)

- **Affixology 3.6.0: move preview, mixed combos and a form wheel.**
  - **Construction Cube moves:** hover a move to see its attack on the preview character; **Play** shows the whole combo. Combos can now mix moves from the One-handed / Dual and Two-handed groups.
  - **Transcendent Remodeling Table:** hover a skill to see its cast animation.
  - **Remodel forms:** drawing a new form opens the full Construction Cube editor. A form keeps to the weapon's own colours and existing 3D parts (parts can be moved, resized, rotated or removed, not added). Success chance is 10% (100% in creative); failure destroys the weapon.
  - **Form wheel:** the switch-form key (**N** in this pack) opens a radial wheel. Hold, point and release, or tap and click. Switching takes 1.5 seconds with an animation, particles and a sound; you cannot attack during it, and other players see it.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1105)

- **Affixology 3.5.0: Construction Cube 3D parts and a Structure Analyzer rework.**
  - **3D parts:** every part has a fine-tune panel (0.1 position/size steps, 1° rotation steps, typed values). Non-block items such as skulls, chains and torches can be dragged in as parts, and block parts can be stretched without changing their texture pixels.
  - **Grip tab:** grip adjustment is now its own tab with a live held-weapon preview.
  - **Edit Weapon:** finished exclusive weapons can now be drawn on and given 3D parts, at twice the material cost.
  - **Part stat bonus:** building blocks add +1 attack/ranged damage and +20% spell power per 4 blocks; metal blocks +1.2 / +1.2 / +25% per 2 blocks; other parts +0.5 / +0.5 / +5% each. Parts added while editing give 20% of that.
  - **Structure Analyzer:** failure chance is fixed at 70%. A failed weapon is no longer destroyed: it becomes a red **[Broken]** item with a random rarity (Common to Legendary), affixes at 40% of their values, 4096 vanilla durability and Curse of Binding, and it can no longer be enhanced, socketed or remodeled.
- **Worldology 1.1.3:** fixes a client crash with Accelerated Rendering when the world-level label above another player is drawn.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1104d)

- **Affixology 3.4.0: the Construction Cube editor is rebuilt.**
  - **3D modeling page:** drag blocks from your inventory into a 3D view to build a weapon out of textured block parts. Width, height and depth are set separately, so parts can be stretched unevenly; drag the handles to resize by hand. Shift-click or Ctrl+A selects several parts, and dragging moves them as a group. A held view shows the player holding the weapon while you adjust the grip, size and thickness.
  - **Moves page (Better Combat):** build a melee combo of up to 4 moves from 22 attacks (slashes, stabs, slams, uppercuts, pommel strikes, sweeps, cleaves, smashes, thrusts, cyclones and more). Each hit plays the next move in order.
  - **Drawing:** layers with depth, palettes and block shapes, undo/redo, item import, and a template library. Bows and crossbows can draw pull frames, which switch while you draw the bow.
- Removed: Dochi's RPG Maker.
- Updated:
  - Leaky - Item Lag Fix 3.7
  - Moonlight Lib 3.8.0
  - Particle Rain 4.0.3
  - Punchy! Moves 1.0.6 hotfix

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1104c)

- **FTB Essentials is back**, with FTB Library: home, back, spawn, teleport-request and the other FTB Essentials commands work again.
- Removed: Configurable Extra Mob Drops and Drippy Loading Screen.
- Updated:
  - Entity Texture Features 7.2.7
  - Punchy! - First person animations 3.1b
  - Punchy! Moves 1.0.6

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1104b)

- b1104b: restores Affixology's equipment category overrides and vanilla weapon support, which b1104 shipped cleared by mistake.

- **Dungeonology 1.3.0: caves look like real caves.** All 20 cave dungeons are now fully enclosed in rock: terraced walls climb away from the floor and a high roof sits above the camera, so there is no open void around the paths. Passages and chambers are wider.
  - **10 new multi-route caves**, where stretches split into two or more tunnels around rock islands: Dripstone Depths, Mycelial Hollows, Verdigris Undercroft, Crimson Warrens, Sunless Dunes, Tidecaller Caves, Glowworm Galleries, Fossil Barrows, Goldhoard Burrows and Terracotta Canyons, each with its own boss.
  - **Party invites:** the party screen (P) has an Invite Players button listing online players.
  - Nothing spawns naturally inside dungeons any more, and wave enemies no longer appear on top of the wall terraces.
  - The dungeon HUD panels no longer draw through each other. Dungeon, boss and rule names are translated in Traditional Chinese.
- **Affixology 3.3.3: mobs no longer drop random affixed weapons.** Affixed gear still comes from dungeon rewards, chests and villager trades. Gem, enhancement stone and identification ticket drops are unchanged. Server owners can turn weapon drops back on with `enableMobWeaponDrops` in `config/savaru_affixes.json`.
- **Click Ping Wheel 1.5.0:** the click-to-move marker is a single thin expanding line. Clicking a mob or NPC marks it with a red box on the ground for 5 seconds.
- **Dungeon Bar 0.3.4:** the bar is always drawn on top, so floating ground-item labels no longer cover it.

## Earlier in 3.0 (b1103)

- **Dungeonology 1.2.0: 10 new cave dungeons.** Long, winding cave runs, each about 400 x 400 blocks, with one route from the entrance to the boss chamber and a new layout every run. Waves of enemies come as you move through, and killing the boss in the last chamber completes the run.
